reason: I already drive down to Spinneys or Tawfeer once a week and fill the boot, and I pick my own fresh things there anyway. Paying a fee to save a few cents on staples, then still collecting at their hour, isn't worth changing that.
objection: I'd still have to go and collect it, at their hour, not mine, and I'm in Jbeil every week regardless. The saving is only half of a small bulk discount, so a bag fee eats most of it.
would_change_my_mind: Free delivery to my door with the saving shown clearly on a first trial order, so I can see I'm really ahead after the fee.
